categories.main_business_segments: Narada Power primarily operates in three segments: new power storage, communication and data center storage, and resource recycling. It provides lithium-ion and lead-acid batteries, system integration, and related services, including hydrogen energy equipment and recycled battery materials. The company also engages in battery recycling and resource regeneration, forming a full industry chain from raw materials to recycling.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on lithium iron phosphate batteries and lead-acid batteries, employing advanced technologies such as large-capacity iron lithium cells, liquid cooling systems, and battery management systems (BMS). It develops solid-state batteries, sodium-ion batteries, and hydrogen energy systems. Narada emphasizes R&D with national labs, collaborations with universities, and proprietary innovations in battery safety, longevity, and energy density.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Narada serves customers in new power storage applications, communication and data center energy storage, and civilian storage sectors. Key customers include telecom operators, data centers, internet companies, financial institutions, and battery manufacturers. Its products are used in grid frequency regulation, peak shaving, backup power, and renewable energy integration.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally, covering over 160 countries and regions. Major markets include China, Europe, North America, Australia, Japan, South Korea, India, and emerging markets like Greece, Sweden, and Finland. It maintains localized sales and service centers to support global operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: Narada operates across the entire lithium and lead battery supply chain, from raw material procurement, battery cell manufacturing, system integration, to operation and maintenance services, and finally resource recycling. This vertical integration enables closed-loop management and cost control advantages.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The strategic focus is on 'Three Integrations and One Fusion'—industrial integration, sales-service integration, global integration, and ecosystem fusion. R&D priorities include advancing solid-state batteries, sodium-ion batteries, hydrogen energy technologies, and recycling processes. The company aims to accelerate technology commercialization, enhance product safety, energy density, and lifespan, and expand its product matrix to meet diverse customer needs.
categories.revenue_model: Narada generates revenue primarily through direct sales of battery products and integrated energy storage systems. It also earns from providing system integration, operation and maintenance services, and sales of recycled battery materials. The company uses a direct sales model combined with agency sales for market expansion.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Narada is a leading global player in the energy storage industry, ranked third in China's global market shipments for energy storage systems and lithium batteries for communication and data centers. It competes with major domestic and international battery manufacturers and system integrators, leveraging its comprehensive industry chain and technological innovation to maintain a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Narada reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 7.98 billion, a 45.56% decrease from the previous year, mainly due to price declines and reduced sales volume in lithium battery products and recycling. The company experienced a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 1.5 billion. Despite short-term challenges, it continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D, with ongoing projects to increase lithium battery production capacity and system integration capabilities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Narada emphasizes its integrated industry chain from raw materials to recycling, advanced battery technologies with high safety and long life, and comprehensive system solutions tailored for diverse applications. Its global certifications and strong brand reputation support its value proposition of reliable, high-quality energy storage products and services. The company also highlights its commitment to sustainability through efficient resource recycling and green manufacturing.
